import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class HungarianMatching {
    static final int SIZE = 2000;
    int cnt,[] pos = new int[SIZE], rev = new int[SIZE];
    int[] v = new int[SIZE];

    public int gao(int n, List<Integer>[] e) {
        cnt = 0;
        Arrays.fill(pos, -1);
        Arrays.fill(rev, -1);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(v, 0);
            if (match(i, e)) {
                cnt++;
            }
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    private boolean match(int x, List<Integer>[] e) {
        for (int y : e[x]) {
            if (v[y] == 0) {
                v[y] = 1;
                if (rev[y] < 0 || match(rev[y], e)) {
                    pos[x] = y;
                    rev[y] = x;
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
}

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 1000000000;
    static final int[] mr = {0, -1, 0, 1};
    static final int[] mc = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[][] a = new int[12][12], b = new int[12][12], f = new int[12][12];
    static int m, t;
    static List<Integer>[] e = new ArrayList[2000];
    static List<Integer>[][] c = new ArrayList[12][12];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 2000; i++) {
            e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < 12; j++) {
                c[i][j] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }
    }

    static void floodfill(int sr, int sc) {
        int[][] dist = new int[12][12];
        for (int[] row : dist) {
            Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        }
        Queue<Integer> qr = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qc = new LinkedList<>();
        qr.offer(sr);
        qc.offer(sc);
        dist[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!qr.isEmpty()) {
            int r = qr.poll();
            int c_ = qc.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int tr = r + mr[i];
                int tc = c_ + mc[i];
                if (tr >= 0 && tr < a.length && tc >= 0 && tc < a[0].length && a[tr][tc] >= 0 && dist[tr][tc] < 0) {
                    dist[tr][tc] = dist[r][c_] + 1;
                    qr.offer(tr);
                    qc.offer(tc);
                }
            }
        }
        // Store distances in f
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < a[0].length; j++) {
                f[i][j] = dist[i][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static void setmark(int sr, int sc, int cnt) {
        int[][] v = new int[12][12];
        for (int[] row : v) {
            Arrays.fill(row, -1);
        }
        Queue<Integer> qr = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qc = new LinkedList<>();
        qr.offer(sr);
        qc.offer(sc);
        v[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!qr.isEmpty()) {
            int r = qr.poll();
            int c_ = qc.poll();
            if (v[r][c_] > Math.min(t, f[r][c_])) continue;
            for (int j = 0; j < c[r][c_].size(); j++) {
                int node = c[r][c_].get(j);
                for (int i = 0; i < cnt; i++) {
                    e[m + i].add(node);
                }
            }
            if (v[r][c_] == Math.min(t, f[r][c_])) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int tr = r + mr[i];
                int tc = c_ + mc[i];
                if (tr >= 0 && tr < a.length && tc >= 0 && tc < a[0].length && a[tr][tc] >= 0 && v[tr][tc] < 0) {
                    v[tr][tc] = v[r][c_] + 1;
                    qr.offer(tr);
                    qc.offer(tc);
                }
            }
        }
        m += cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        t = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(a[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(b[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(f[i], -1);
        }
        int sr = -1, sc = -1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    a[i][j] = ch - '0';
                }
                if (ch == 'Z') {
                    sr = i;
                    sc = j;
                }
            }
        }
        floodfill(sr, sc);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            br.readLine(); // skip empty line
        }
        int o = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j - 1);
                if (ch >= '0' && ch <= '9') {
                    b[i][j] = ch - '0';
                }
                for (int k = 0; k < b[i][j]; k++) {
                    c[i][j].add(o++);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (f[i][j] < 0) {
                    f[i][j] = INF;
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                if (a[i][j] > 0) {
                    setmark(i, j, a[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }
        HungarianMatching match = new HungarianMatching();
        System.out.println(match.gao(m, e));
    }
}
